anti_fabrication: No result is PASS unless the experiment actually ran and its evidence supports it. BLOCKED/NOT_RUN are never promoted.

blockers.model_backed_agent_task: No LLM credentials or local model. Phase 1 harness is designed not to need one, so M1 is not blocked by this; a genuinely model-driven task is.
blockers.kprobe_observation: Kernel built without CONFIG_KPROBES; kprobe-based observation out of reach on this host.
blockers.off_host_collector_custody: Collector runs on the same host (separate process, sole key holder). Host-separated administrative custody not available here.
